text: When both engines died, this little propeller saved sixty-nine people. A seven sixty-seven is steered with hydraulic pressure, and the pumps were powered by the engines. No engines, no steering. So a small propeller drops out of the belly. The ram air turbine. The rushing wind spins it, and it drives a hydraulic pump, just enough to move the controls. For seventeen minutes, the pilots steered a silent jet with wind power. Where they landed is unbelievable. Full video on my channel.
